newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline $1 lower on barges, $3 on swaps.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline $1 lower on barges, $3 on swaps.

text.p: NWE gasoline values fell back by around $1 on Monday on prompt barges, but by around $3 on swaps, as earlier indications of heavier declines were partly reversed.
Two Eurograde barge trades for balance-of-August at $226 FOB Rotterdam running refinery, $1 below Friday values, left earlier bid and notional offer talk as low as $224 redundant, dealers said.
Traders rejected the view of some participants that the market was overvalued and better supplied, saying they found it extremely difficult to locate required barges.
Regular price ideas were still around $6 below Eurograde, while Eurograde first half September barges were mentioned around $210.
Swaps fell back to $196.50-$198 for September, $3-$3.50 lower than Friday, partly on the back of a heavy decline in NYMEX unleaded gasoline.
